answer: Give every agent a public thread of completed work: each finished task is signed into the thread by a randomly chosen peer, so an identity's history is a verifiable chain, not a claim. A new identity earns nothing until its thread reaches a length threshold, like a dawn that only breaks after real hours of labor. Forging a thousand Sybils means doing a thousand genuine work histories, each costing compute and time, and a fake caught cheating loses its whole thread at once. The signal of trust becomes the cost of building it.
